cases.description: All bytes are valid Base64 characters ("Man" encoded as "TWFu"). The method should iterate through the whole array and return true.
Array contains every character from the standard Base64 alphabet. The method must recognise each as Base64 and return true.
An empty byte array contains no non‑Base64 characters, so the method should return true.
Array consists solely of whitespace characters (space, tab, CR, LF). Whitespace is ignored by the method, therefore it should return true.

group: Base64.isBase64(byte[]) - Valid Base64 with interleaved whitespace

cases.description: Valid Base64 string "TWFu" ("Man") with spaces and a newline inserted. Whitespace must be ignored and the method should still return true.
Base64 padding character '=' is considered a valid Base64 byte. The method should return true for a correctly padded string.
The byte '@' is not part of the Base64 alphabet and not whitespace, so the method must return false.

group: Base64.isBase64(byte[]) - Mixed valid and invalid characters

cases.description: Array contains a mix of valid Base64 characters, whitespace, and an invalid exclamation mark '!'. Presence of any non‑Base64, non‑whitespace byte forces a false result.
Passing a null reference should cause a NullPointerException when the method attempts to iterate over the array.
Byte value 0xFF (‑1 as a signed byte) is not whitespace and not part of the Base64 alphabet; the method must return false.
